note: Synthetic homepages for finding the Impressum, privacy policy and accessibility statement links (session A4). Every company and place is invented; every domain ends in .example (RFC 2606). Values are the href attribute exactly as written. A link counts when its visible text (or, without text, its aria-label or title) names it; links in the footer (<footer>, role="contentinfo", or an element whose id or class contains "footer") come first, otherwise the first match in document order; only if no text matches, a link whose href path contains impressum/imprint/legal-notice or datenschutz/privacy. javascript: links and a bare "#" never count; consent settings links (Datenschutz-Einstellungen, Cookie-Einstellungen, Privatsphäre-Einstellungen, Privacy settings, Cookie settings) are not the privacy policy; accessibility toolbar links are not a statement. null means "nicht gefunden, bitte manuell prüfen"; no address such as /impressum is ever guessed.

01-footer-deutsch.description: Basic German homepage: "Impressum" and "Datenschutz" links in a <footer>, plus AGB.

02-englisch.description: English site: "Imprint", "Privacy Policy" and "Accessibility Statement" in the footer.

03-kombinierter-link.description: One combined footer link "Impressum & Datenschutz" (href without either word) serves both: impressum and datenschutz are the same href.

04-einstellungen-vor-datenschutz.description: Consent settings links "Datenschutz-Einstellungen" (href "#") and "Cookie-Einstellungen" (javascript:) come before the real "Datenschutzerklärung" link in the footer; the real one is expected.

05-ohne-impressum-link.description: No Impressum and no privacy link at all, only "Kontakt" and "Über uns"; the word "Impressum" appears as plain text without a link. Both null, and no address such as /impressum may be guessed.

06-icon-links-aria.description: Icon-only footer links without text: the Impressum link is named by aria-label, the privacy link by title.

07-bildlink-href-fallback.description: The Impressum link is an image with an empty alt and no aria-label or title, so no link text matches; the href fallback ("impressum" in the path) finds it.

08-onepager-anker.description: One-pager: the footer links are same-page anchors "#impressum" and "#datenschutz" to sections further down.

09-header-und-footer.description: The header navigation has "Impressum" and "Datenschutz" links to other paths before the footer links; the footer links win.

10-toolbar-und-erklaerung.description: A header link "Barrierefreiheit" with href "#" opens an accessibility toolbar; the real "Erklärung zur Barrierefreiheit" link is in the footer and is expected.

11-impressum-als-pdf.description: The Impressum link points to a PDF file.

12-anbieterkennzeichnung.description: The Impressum link text is "Anbieterkennzeichnung", the privacy link text is "Datenschutzhinweise".

13-shop-policies.description: Shop-style policy paths: "Impressum" to /policies/legal-notice and "Datenschutzerklärung" to /policies/privacy-policy, next to AGB and Widerrufsbelehrung policies.

14-viele-links-davor.description: An inline script adds 1,600 category links to a navigation before the footer; the footer with Impressum, Datenschutz and a "Barrierefreiheit" statement link comes after them in document order.

15-site-notice-privacy-notice.description: English link texts "Site notice", "Privacy notice" and "Accessibility" (a statement page, not a toolbar).

16-kontakt-impressum.description: Combined text "Kontakt / Impressum"; privacy link text "Datenschutzinformationen" after a consent link "Privatsphäre-Einstellungen" (href "#").

17-impressum-nur-javascript.description: The only Impressum link has a javascript: href (it opens a layer), which does not count, and no href contains the word: impressum null (manual check). The privacy link is normal.

18-footer-per-klasse.description: No <footer> element: the footer is a div with class "site-footer". Blog teaser links with "Impressum" and "Datenschutz" in their text come earlier in the main part; the footer links win.

19-absolute-urls-contentinfo.description: Footer as a div with role="contentinfo"; absolute links, the privacy policy on another .example host; a consent link "Cookie-Einstellungen" (href "#") comes first.

20-grossbuchstaben-verschachtelt.description: Link texts in capitals and nested in spans: "IMPRESSUM" in capitals in the DOM next to a symbol span, "Datenschutz" shown in capitals by CSS text-transform.

21-legal-notice-data-protection.description: English footer: consent links "Privacy settings" (href "#") and "Cookie settings" (javascript:) before "Legal notice" and "Data protection"; the real ones are expected.

22-href-fallback-beide.description: The footer links have unrelated texts ("Rechtliches", "Hinweise"); no link text matches, so the href fallback finds /rechtliches/impressum and /rechtliches/datenschutz.
